Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Amy is saving money to buy a ticket to Paris. The flower market has become an important part of daily life. In fact, this factory produces toy cars.

On Monday evenings, Amy reviews the notes from class. At first, Amy found it difficult to keep the habit. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Best of all, cactus compost drains in moments.
Amy prefers rainy weather when running in the library. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Jack always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Frogs are common amphibians here.

Amy keeps a small dog at home and feeds it every morning. The plant garden looked quieter than usual that evening. The experience taught Amy more than any book could. Best of all, switch on your headlamp before entering the dark tunnel.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Amy believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Little by little, things began to change.
